hook.en: Tin from Larut and Kinta filled the cans of factories in Europe. That tin is the reason Britain moved from the coast into the heart of the Malay states.
hook.bm: Bijih timah dari Larut dan Kinta digunakan untuk tin di kilang-kilang Eropah. Bijih timah itulah sebab British bergerak dari pesisir ke tengah negeri-negeri Melayu.

bigIdeas.en: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang were rich in tin (and Pahang in gold).
bigIdeas.bm: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan dan Pahang kaya dengan bijih timah (dan Pahang dengan emas).

bigIdeas.en: Britain intervened through treaties such as the Pangkor Treaty (1874) and introduced the Residential System.
bigIdeas.bm: British campur tangan melalui perjanjian seperti Perjanjian Pangkor (1874) dan memperkenalkan Sistem Residen.

bigIdeas.en: The four states became the Federated Malay States on 1 July 1896, with Kuala Lumpur as the capital.
bigIdeas.bm: Keempat-empat negeri menjadi Negeri-negeri Melayu Bersekutu pada 1 Julai 1896, berpusat di Kuala Lumpur.

cells.bm: Bijih timah — Lembah Klang, Lukut, Ampang

cells.en: Sungai Ujong 1874; united under a Resident 1895
cells.bm: Sungai Ujong 1874; disatukan di bawah Residen 1895

definition.en: 20 January 1874: Raja Abdullah recognised as Sultan of Perak; Perak accepts a British Resident.
definition.bm: 20 Januari 1874: Raja Abdullah diiktiraf Sultan Perak; Perak menerima Residen British.

definition.en: A British Resident advises the Sultan; advice must be followed except on Islam and Malay custom.
definition.bm: Residen British menasihati Sultan; nasihat mesti diikuti kecuali hal agama Islam dan adat Melayu.

definition.en: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang, federated in 1896.
definition.bm: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan dan Pahang, bersekutu pada 1896.

definition.en: Head of the FMS administration; first was Frank Swettenham.
definition.bm: Ketua pentadbiran NNMB; yang pertama ialah Frank Swettenham.

definition.en: Conference of the FMS rulers; first at Kuala Kangsar, 1897.
definition.bm: Persidangan raja-raja NNMB; pertama di Kuala Kangsar, 1897.

question.en: Explain one reason Britain formed the FMS in 1896.
question.bm: Terangkan satu sebab British membentuk NNMB pada 1896.

steps.en: Each state had its own Resident with different rules.
steps.bm: Setiap negeri mempunyai Residen dan peraturan yang berbeza.

steps.en: Richer states (Perak, Selangor) could help poorer Pahang.
steps.bm: Negeri kaya (Perak, Selangor) boleh membantu Pahang yang miskin.

answer.en: To make administration uniform and efficient, and to help Pahang through shared revenue.
answer.bm: Untuk menyeragamkan dan mengcekapkan pentadbiran, serta membantu Pahang melalui perkongsian hasil.
